questions.question: The most crucial parameter that directly limits theoretical resolution in electron microscopy is
The electron source which provides the highest brightness and best spatial resolution in modern electron microscopes is
Which type of electrons is primarily detected to produce surface images in conventional SEM?
What is the main principle of SEM?

answers.a: Use of visible light to observe specimens
answers.b: Scanning a specimen surface with a focused electron beam
answers.c: Separation of proteins by molecular weight

questions.question: Why are biological samples commonly coated with gold or gold-palladium before SEM analysis?

answers.b: To improve electrical conductivity and reduce charging

questions.question: Which component generates the electron beam in an SEM?

answers.c: Objective lens of a light microscope

questions.question: Resolving power of a microscope depends upon the

answers.a: Focal length and aperture of the eye lens
answers.b: Focal length and objective of the eye lens
answers.c: Apertures of the objective and the eye lens
answers.d: Wavelength of light illuminating the object

questions.question: Which type of information is mainly obtained using SEM?
Which detector is commonly used to collect backscattered electrons in SEM?
What is the major difference between SEM and TEM?

answers.a: SEM studies surface morphology, whereas TEM examines internal ultrastructure
answers.b: SEM uses visible light, whereas TEM uses fluorescent light
answers.c: SEM detects DNA, whereas TEM detects RNA
answers.d: SEM uses sound waves, whereas TEM uses electrons
